name: home-assistant-developer
description: Develop Home Assistant custom integrations and Lovelace cards using current developer documentation.

interface.longDescription: Two skills for developers building Home Assistant custom integrations and Lovelace cards. Create, review, debug, and maintain Python integrations, config flows, entities, coordinators, custom cards, and card editors using current Home Assistant developer documentation. Includes guidance on integration quality rules, testing, and frontend APIs. This plugin provides development instructions; it does not connect to or control a Home Assistant instance.
defaultPrompt: Help me build a Home Assistant custom integration.
Help me create a Lovelace card and its editor.
Review my Home Assistant integration against the Bronze quality rules.
